_what: The standing instructions Trillion keeps in an AI's own harness instruction file, one short marked block, read by read-data/standing-instructions.mjs and kept by tool:keep-trillion-in-your-instructions. `text` is the block's content and is the one place to change it: the engine keeps the installed Workshop current (its keep-current row), so a change here reaches the person's computer with the next Workshop it installs. `markers` bracket the block; only the lines between them (and the two marker lines) are ever written or removed, every other byte of the file is left as it was. `harnesses`: where each harness keeps its instructions, copied from the engine's product/harnesses.json `standing_instructions` (kind file: `file` inside the folder the person granted this tool, `folder` naming the folder under the home folder the harness uses by default; kind host-control: no file, the AI uses the named control of the app itself).
text: At the start of a conversation, read recent Trillion messages, pursuits and relevant assigned work. Do the authorized work and check its outcome. Use decisions and workflows when they help; routine answers, edits and fixes need no external-method prerequisite. Report the real result in plain words.

standing_instructions.control: its own memory or custom instructions
ChatGPT's Custom instructions or Memory in its personalization settings
Claude's personal preferences or memory in its settings
Gemini's saved info or instructions for Gemini in its settings
Grok's custom instructions in its settings
Cursor's User Rules in its settings
